verses.1: A song of praise for Asaf.
verses.2: God, do not abandon me. Do not let me be alone or feel sad.
verses.3: For behold, your enemies are rising up against you, and those who hate you are taking control.
verses.4: Over your people, they will raise a curse and speak evil of you.
verses.5: They said, “Go away from this land. They will no longer remember the name of Israel.”
verses.6: For their hearts have been united together; they will make a covenant with you.
verses.7: The houses of Adam and Eve, and the sons of Noah and the people of Israel.
verses.8: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, along with the inhabitants of Zoar.
verses.9: Ashur also suffered along with them. They were like the branches of a tree that were broken.
verses.10: Do to them what Midian did to Sisra, as Yavin did to Kishon.
verses.11: They were destroyed in Eye-Dor; they became a symbol of destruction.
verses.12: He is generous, like a bird that flies and soars; like a bird that sings and plays music; like a bird that is always in motion.
verses.13: They said, “Nirsha has given us the blessings of God.”
verses.14: The sun rises like a disc, like a blade before the wind.
verses.15: Like fire that burns through a forest, and like light that illuminates the mountains.
verses.16: So they will be pursued by your storms and your winds; they will be terrified.
verses.17: May their faces be covered with shame, and may they ask for your name, O LORD.
verses.18: They will be terrified and flee for their lives. They will dig in search of refuge, but they will still be destroyed.
verses.19: And they shall know that You, LORD, are alone, without any other god on all the earth.
